text in front of this query — only the curated anchor can, which is what

Exodus 20:1-17 anchor range; Exod 20 stays alsoAcceptable.
'day of rest' is the one query here sharing the token `rest` with
rest-for-the-weary's territory; its Matt 11:28-30 ranking for that query
would be honest, hence no mustNotRank — the assert is only that the
20:8-11 leads these queries - it says 'sabbath' lexically, carries the
ten-commandments related-theme chip, and cross-references Gen 2 - and
renders as several verse rows, putting Gen 2:3 at #4-5. The command
text leading a 'sabbath' query is honest ordering; the assertion stays
that the origin text surfaces on the anchor's authority.
